title: Grateful Dead Live at Baltimore Civic Center on 1973-03-26
lineage: SBD> MR> DAT> CDA> CDA> EAC> SHN

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard recording captures a stellar 1973 show, highlighted by the jam‑filled Wharf Rat/WRS segue and Jerry Garcia's soaring Candyman solo.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the excellent guitar tone on Candyman, the slide‑laden Truckin' jam into the Wharf Rat prelude, and the overall energy of this March ’73 performance. The soundboard mix is generally clear and punchy, though a few listeners note annoying tuning gaps placed at song starts and occasional streaming skips. Overall the show is regarded as one of the standout 1973 concerts.

ai_rating.rationale: Average rating ≈4.1 from 22 reviews, with overwhelming positive comments on both performance and sound quality; only minor technical complaints.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp mix with strong Jerry guitar tone and clear vocals; some listeners find tuning gaps at the start of tracks annoying and report occasional stream‑skip issues, but overall the recording is solid.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set delivers solid tour standards with occasional jams (e.g., PITB). The second set shines with an expanded WRS prelude jam, Wolfman Jack’s intro, and a flowing sequence that builds to the Wharf Rat climax.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's tone is praised on Candyman (vibrato‑rich solo) and his slide work on the Truckin' jam; vocals noted as deep and clear though slightly off at times.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s backing vocal contributions are highlighted, especially harmonies with Donna Jean on songs like Box of Rain and BIODTL.
